about: omher's one masker for token-like text: the bridge (mask_secrets), the desktop shell (tasks.rs mask_secrets) and the page (src/lib/secrets.ts) all use these two patterns, and secrets.cases.json holds the table all three test against. `tokens` is replaced whole by `mask`; it also takes a token broken by line breaks or a space (up to four breaks), joining a next piece only when that piece is token-shaped (two or more capitals or digits), so a prose word after the break stays. `assigned` (case-insensitive) keeps its name and `=` and replaces the value.
